label: 1–3 years
notes: Toddler/early childhood; rapid growth; sex-neutral DRI values

label: 4–8 years
notes: Childhood; steady growth; sex-neutral DRI values

label: 9–13 years
notes: Pre-adolescent; puberty onset; sex-specific DRI values begin (fiber, water, iron)

label: 14–18 years
notes: Adolescent; higher calcium (1300mg) and phosphorus (1250mg) needs for bone development

label: 19–30 years
notes: Young adult; peak bone mass achieved in this period

label: 31–50 years
notes: Adult; most common pregnancy age range

label: 51+ years
notes: Older adult; IOM combines 51-70 and 71+ for most nutrients. Higher calcium for females, lower iron post-menopause.
